data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Heavy Losses Reported Across Several Contested Regions
previous_model_summary.war_summary: On the 203rd day of the present campaign the wires report a war of sharp contrasts, with most districts holding quiet and without a recorded change while a handful of sectors furnish all the action. The Weathered Expanse leads the ledger with 46 base changes in the day, five in the last two hours, and holdings now standing three Colonial, five Warden and one destroyed, alongside more than eight thousand Colonial and nine thousand Warden casualties in 24 hours. Linn Mercy and Dead Lands follow with heavy losses and 19 and 16 changes respectively, the former divided seven to four and the latter now listed wholly Colonial despite continued fighting. Stlican Shelf counts 38 changes with Wardens holding eight to one, while Callahan's Passage shows nine changes, one base in ruins, and a sharp rise in hourly losses. Farranac Coast and Stonecradle add heavy casualty bills but no late flips, and enlistment returns show fresh men still arriving across the lines.
